section.title: Jurisdiction and Venue
section.para: Claims arise under the First Amendment (federal constitutional), California Constitution Art. I §2 (state constitutional — speech broader than federal floor), California Business and Professions Code § 17200 (unfair business practices), and federal Section 230 (where platform immunity is being argued against claims here). Federal constitutional claims invoke federal court jurisdiction; state constitutional claims can be heard in CA Superior Court.

Constitutional scope: Federal constitutional (1st Amendment limits on automated decision systems); California constitutional (Art. I §2 broader speech protection); federal statutory (Section 230 scope and limits); California statutory (B&P § 17200 unfair practices).
Lower courts cannot resolve the federal or state constitutional questions — these must be preserved for appellate review or filed directly in appropriate federal or state courts.
